# Priscilla Grant

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden. Despite her appearance, she is filled with mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, Priscilla Grant is known for a lively disposition. She is constantly full of fun, mischief, and a penchant for playing pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant became a student at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She made friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while attending the school and maintained her academic focus as examination time approached.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV.
